name: Classic Potato Salad

ingredients.name: russet potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 3/4 inch cubes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and cut the russet potatoes into 3/4 inch cubes. Finely dice the celery. Finely dice the red onion. Chop the cornichons.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium russet potatoes
3 ribs celery
2 medium red onion
¼ cup cornichons

instructions.primary_message: Add 2 quarts water to a large saucepan. Add potatoes, 2 tablespoons kosher salt, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 2 tablespoons vinegar. Bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Drain potatoes and transfer to rimmed baking sheet. Spread into even layer, then sprinkle with 2 tablespoons vinegar. Allow to cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.

In a large bowl, combine remaining 2 tablespoons sugar, remaining 2 tablespoons vinegar, celery, onion, scallion (if using), parsley (if using), pickles, mustard, and mayonnaise. Stir with rubber spatula to combine. Fold in potatoes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover and rest in fridge for at least 1 hour and up to 3 days before serving.

description: Tangy, salty, and sweet with a texture that's simultaneously creamy, crunchy, and fluffy in each bite, a perfect potato salad should taste feather-light, despite being made with potato and mayo, two of the heaviest ingredients around.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 50 min.

Optional or for serving: 4 medium scallions, green parts only, thinly sliced (about 1/2 cup, optional); 1/4 cup fresh parsley leaves, washed and minced (optional)

Notes: Cornichons are small salty pickles that can be found in most grocery stores. If unavailable, regular dill pickles or pickle relish can be used in its place.

Make-ahead and storage: Salad can be prepared 3 days in advance. Store in refrigerator.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
